name: Blistercap Spore
body:
Price 1,125 gp; Weight 1 lb.

ABOUT

Found in remote regions deep underground, the blistercap takes its name from the blisters on the bruise-colored cap atop its stem, which weep a toxic yellow fluid. The spores it produces often contribute to the dangers of underground exploration.

DETAILS

Type poison, contact; Save Fortitude DC 20; Frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; Cure 2 consecutive saves.

EFFECT

Initial Effect: 1d2 Dex drain and 1 Con drain.

Secondary Effect: Sickened for 1 minute.
